For Marx this contradiction illustrated the crisis-ridden nature of capitalism and its tendency toward internal conflict and eventual collapse. But it could equally be taken to illuminate the continuous force of noncapitalist elements within the core of what is called capitalism. To describe the joint-stock corporation as the relatively recent outcome of the internal development of capitalism implies that market capitalism came into being first and the large corporation arrived afterward, setting limits to the market and contradicting its logic. Given the power that global corporations had reestablished by the end of the twentieth century, it is important to recall that, if anything, the history of the market and the corporation happened the other way around. The major institutions for organizing large-scale global trade in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries were not markets but monopolistic colonizing corporations, such as the Dutch and English East India companies and the jointstock companies that were given monopolies for the colonization of North America.

Neoclassical economists like to trace the origins of their field to the formulation of the market principle in the classical work of Adam Smith. But Smith wrote The Wealth of Nations as an attack on the power of these colonizing corporations and formulated the idea of individual exchange in “the market” as the program for an alternative. He devoted long sections of the book to discussing the world’s first successful campaign against the corporate monopolies, the revolt of Britain’s American colonies, and to examining the simultaneous crisis in the largest such monopoly, the East India Company. Writings such as The Wealth of Nations helped to construct the idea of the “self-regulating market” as a novel alternative to corporate power, and this and subsequent writings in political economy began to formulate the market’s rules and principles. But the idea of “the market” was not the only response to the crisis of the colonizing corporation. In 1776, the year The Wealth of Nations appeared, two alternative methods of governing the wealth of nations were devised. The American colonists articulated an antimarket principle of economic organization, the nation-state; and the East India Company proposed a new system of colonial government, the Plan of Settlement, recasting arbitrary corporate power as a colonial “rule of property.”

Within fifty years, moreover, the United States and Britain began to resort once more to the joint-stock corporation as an institution with which to organize nonmarket transactions. As I mentioned in chapter 3, the unusual legal powers of incorporation were no longer restricted to ostensibly public projects, such as colonization, but were made available for any large economic purpose. At the same time, further projects of colonization were undertaken by Americans and Europeans using the new powers of the state itself. So the framing of the market once again was limited by the larger and more significant framings of the corporation and the colonial monopoly.
zh: 到马克思起草《资本论》第三卷时，他意识到现代公司代表了他第一卷中概述的资本主义原则的断裂。他把股份公司描述为“在资本主义生产方式本身内部对资本主义生产方式的废除”。

对马克思而言，这一矛盾说明了资本主义充满危机的性质及其内部冲突和最终崩溃的倾向。但它同样可以被用来阐明非资本主义要素在所谓资本主义核心内部持续的力量。把股份公司描述为资本主义内部发展相对较新的结果，意味着市场资本主义先产生，大公司随后出现，为市场设定限制并与其逻辑相矛盾。鉴于全球公司在20世纪末重新确立的权力，重要的是要记得：市场与公司的历史，如果说有什么不同，恰恰是反过来发生的。17和18世纪组织大规模全球贸易的主要制度不是市场，而是垄断性的殖民公司，如荷兰和英国东印度公司，以及获得北美殖民垄断权的股份公司。

新古典经济学家喜欢把本学科的起源追溯到亚当·斯密经典著作中对市场原则的阐述。但斯密写《国富论》是为了抨击这些殖民公司的权力，并把“市场”中个人交换的观念表述为另一种替代方案。他在书中用了很长篇幅讨论世界上第一场成功的反公司垄断运动——英国美洲殖民地的反抗，并考察当时最大的此类垄断企业东印度公司的同步危机。《国富论》这类著作帮助把“自我调节的市场”观念建构为一种对抗公司权力的新颖替代方案，该书及随后的政治经济学著作开始阐述市场的规则和原则。但“市场”观念并不是对殖民公司危机的唯一回应。1776年，即《国富论》问世之年，人们设计了两种治理国家财富的替代方法。美洲殖民地人民阐明了民族国家这一反市场的经济组织原则；东印度公司则提出了一套新的殖民政府制度“定居计划”（Plan of Settlement），把任意的公司权力重塑为殖民地“财产统治”。
此外，五十年之内，美国和英国又开始诉诸股份公司，把它作为组织非市场交易的制度。正如我在第3章提到的，公司设立的特殊法律权力不再限于表面上的公共项目，如殖民，而是可用于任何大型经济目的。与此同时，美国人和欧洲人利用国家本身的新权力，开展了进一步的殖民项目。因此，市场的框架再次受到公司和殖民垄断这些更大、更重要的框架的限制。

en: The point of this historical detour is the following. By the twentieth century the colonizing corporation had been replaced by directly ruled colonies on the one hand and modern joint-stock companies on the other, the largest of which developed into transnational corporations far larger than most postcolonial states. By mid-century the system of colonies was giving way in most places to one of nation-states. Like the colony, the nation provided a nonmarket method for organizing economic exchange, especially for preventing free markets in labor and money. Since the science of economics had concentrated its efforts on framing the rules of the market, parallel fields of expertise emerged to help coordinate the forms of knowledge needed for the nonmarket institutions: for the corporation, law, accounting, and business studies; for the nation, statistical organizations and the field of macroeconomics, which as we have seen developed around the concept of “the economy” in the middle decades of the century. In addition immigration laws, national banks or reserve systems, complex taxation and tariff systems, and extensive state planning and investment all helped to fabricate the twentiethcentury nation/economy, as, like the family network, an alternative to the market. The practices that attempt to frame the economy are not only those that regulate the act of market exchange. They include other forms of social network, powers of desire, technologies of control, and modes of government. Each of these, like the regulations of the market, constitutes both a limit and a horizon, opening the economic to other forces and logics.
zh: 这段历史迂回的要旨如下。到20世纪，殖民公司在一边被直接统治的殖民地取代，在另一边被现代股份公司取代；其中最大的股份公司发展为远大于大多数后殖民国家的跨国公司。到20世纪中叶，殖民地体系在大多数地方让位于民族国家体系。像殖民地一样，民族国家提供了一种组织经济交换的非市场方法，尤其用于防止劳动和货币的自由市场。由于经济学集中力量为市场规则设定框架，平行领域的专业知识便应运而生，帮助协调非市场制度所需的知识形式：为公司服务的是法律、会计和商业研究；为国家服务的是统计机构和宏观经济学领域——如我们所见，后者在20世纪中叶围绕“经济”概念发展起来。此外，移民法、国家银行或储备体系、复杂的税收和关税制度，以及广泛的国家计划和投资，都帮助制造了20世纪的民族国家/经济，使之像家族网络一样成为市场的替代物。试图为经济设定框架的实践，不只是调节市场交换行为的实践。它们包括其他形式的社会网络、欲望的力量、控制技术和治理方式。其中每一项，如同市场的规制一样，都既构成限制又构成地平线，向其他力量和逻辑敞开经济。

en: The second general point concerns the question of violence. The market, the family, the economy, and the nation can all be understood as institutions, based on the operation of rules and conventions. The notion of “framing” used to describe the working of such institutions is often derived from the work of Erving Goffman, who made particular use of metaphors from the theater.

This choice of language and metaphor can give the impression of an essentially benign process, in which rules and roles operate by convention, and coercion has only a residual or reserve function. This reflects a tradition that sees rules and violence, law and coercion, as opposites. One is based upon reason, on the application of principles “unquestionably true in every country.”

The other is an element of irrationality and disorder. However, as I argued in the case of property in chapter 2, the opposing of law to violence is misleading. The opposition is itself an effect of the methods of enframing that enable an abstract code or structure of rules to appear separate from the practices in which they are brought into being and reproduced. The act of enframing is a work of force as much as reason, and the two should not be seen as opposites but examined together.
zh: 第二个一般性观点涉及暴力问题。市场、家庭、经济和民族都可以被理解为制度，建立在规则和惯例的运作之上。用来描述这类制度运作的“框架”概念，常常源自欧文·戈夫曼的著作，他特别借用了戏剧的隐喻。
这种语言和隐喻的选择可能给人以一种本质上良性的过程印象：规则和角色按惯例运作，强制只具有残余或储备的功能。这反映了一种把规则与暴力、法律与强制视为对立面的传统。其中一方基于理性，基于应用“在每个国家都无可置疑地为真”的原则。
另一方则是不理性和混乱的要素。然而，正如我在第2章关于财产的讨论中所论证的，把法律与暴力对立起来具有误导性。这种对立本身就是框架化方法的效果，这些方法使抽象的规则法典或结构显得与产生和再生产它们的实践相分离。框架化的行为既是理性的工作，也是力量的工作，二者不应被看作对立面，而应放在一起考察。

en: In the Egyptian economic reforms, the reports of the IMF and other bodies describing the plan and progress of reform had nothing to say on the question of the kinds of force and coercion that were required. Yet if one follows closely the way in which economic expertise carried out its free-market experiment, it becomes clear that this scientific experiment could only have been conducted by force. Alternative claims, costs, visions, and agendas had to be kept out of the picture, using various combinations of persuasion, argument, threat, and violence. Those pursuing alternative political agendas in Egypt had very little space for maneuver before the economic reforms, although the judiciary, the press, opposition political parties, religious groups, universities, human rights organizations, and professional associations all offered limited arenas in which people could criticize the authorities and challenge aspects of the state’s political program. The economic reforms were facilitated by a continuous narrowing of these limited opportunities for dissent. The new repressions included a parliament more than one hundred of whose members the courts declared fraudulently elected, but that announced itself to be above the law in such matters; and in which the handful of opposition deputies were increasingly deprived of opportunities to question the government.
It included removing the right of villagers to select their own heads, of religious communities to choose their own preachers, and of university faculties to elect their deans.

It included a regime that admitted no right to organize political opposition or hold political meetings, and allowed the few legal opposition parties no right to public activities. It included a steady remilitarization of power, especially as control shifted away from ministries, many of which were now run by technocrats, to provincial governors, most of whom were still appointed from the high ranks of the military. It included the systematic use of torture against those detained in police stations and the offices of the State Security Intelligence, including electric shocks, beatings, suspension by the wrists or ankles, and threats of death or sexual abuse of the detainee or a female relative.

It included prisons holding tens of thousands of political prisoners, detained without court orders or judicial process, under emergency powers in place for twenty years, in conditions described as cruel, inhuman, or degrading.

It included the silencing of professional associations, with the engineers’ and lawyers’ associations placed under judicial sequestration in 1996, and the doctors’, pharmacists’, teachers’, and scientists’ associations prevented from holding elections.
And it included the repeated intimidation of human rights workers and opposition journalists by closures, court cases, and imprisonment.

In 1999 the regime consolidated these new restrictions by passing a law on civic associations that dissolved all the country’s licensed nongovernmental organizations and required them to apply for permission to re-form under new and more restrictive regulations, including a ban on any activity the state considered political. Meanwhile, the United States and other Western governments refused every appeal to speak out in public on these issues. Washington quietly dropped the “Democracy Initiative” it had introduced in the early 1990s, when political transformations in Eastern Europe seemed to threaten the system of autocracy it had helped sustain in the Middle East, and declared no serious concerns in Egypt beyond the endurance of the regime and its neoliberal reforms.
zh: 在埃及经济改革中，IMF和其他机构描述改革计划与进展的报告，对所需的力量和强制类型问题只字未提。然而，如果密切追踪经济学专业知识进行自由市场实验的方式，就会清楚看出，这场科学实验只有依靠强力才能进行。必须用说服、论证、威胁和暴力的各种组合，把另类的主张、成本、愿景和议程挡在画面之外。在经济改革之前，在埃及追求另类政治议程的人可回旋的空间已经很小，尽管司法机构、新闻界、反对党、宗教团体、大学、人权组织和专业协会都提供了有限的场域，让人们可以批评当局并挑战国家政治计划的某些方面。经济改革得益于这些有限的异见机会不断收窄。新的压制包括：一个法院宣布其一百多名议员系舞弊当选、却又宣称自己在此类事项上高于法律的议会；在这个议会中，少数反对派议员越来越被剥夺质询政府的机会。
它包括取消村民选举村长的权利、宗教社群选择自己传道人的权利，以及大学院系选举院长的权利。
它包括一个不承认组织政治反对派或举行政治集会之权利的政权，也不给予少数合法反对党公开活动的权利。它包括权力的稳步再军事化，尤其是控制权从许多现在由技术官僚管理的部委，转向多数仍从军方高层任命的省长。它包括对在警察局和国家安全情报局办公室被拘留者系统性地使用酷刑，包括电击、殴打、悬吊手腕或脚踝，以及威胁杀害或性侵被拘留者本人或其女性亲属。
它包括关押着数万名政治犯的监狱，这些人在未经法院命令或司法程序的情况下被拘留，依据的是已实施二十年的紧急权力，条件被描述为残忍、不人道或有辱人格。
它包括压制专业协会的发言，工程师协会和律师协会于1996年被置于司法监管之下，医生、药剂师、教师和科学家协会被阻止举行选举。
还包括通过查封、诉讼和监禁，反复恐吓人权工作者和反对派记者。

1999年，该政权通过一项关于公民结社的法律来巩固这些新限制：解散该国所有持牌非政府组织，要求它们根据新的、更严格的法规申请重新组建的许可，包括禁止国家认为属于政治的任何活动。与此同时，美国和其他西方政府拒绝了一切公开就这些问题发声的呼吁。华盛顿悄悄放弃了1990年代初提出的“民主倡议”——当时东欧的政治转变似乎威胁到它在中东帮助维持的专制制度——并宣布，除了该政权的延续及其新自由主义改革之外，在埃及没有严重关切。

en: It is not uncommon, among the proponents as well as critics of the reforms, to admit that structural adjustment and the opening of markets may be accompanied by political repression. However, the tendency is to see one as the consequence as the other, and in that way make the violence something secondary. From a perspective that favors the market, the repression is an unforeseen, unfortunate, intermittent, and probably temporary side effect of the shocks that accompany the expansion of the global market. From a more critical perspective, that of the Marxist tradition, violence is a common instrument of capitalist development, in particular the penetration of capitalist relations into new territories. It is often required to speed up the development of capitalism “like a hot-house,” as Marx himself put it, in regions where changes in the relations of production have lagged behind the global history of capital.
For this reason, however, violence must be considered “a common contingency” rather than something “logically necessary.”

It aids the logic of capital, but, as an element of randomness and unpredictability, or as a means of simply forcing the pace of history, it must be contingent or external to the logic of history itself.
zh: 在改革的支持者和批评者中，承认结构调整和市场开放可能伴随政治压制，并不罕见。然而，人们倾向于把一方看作另一方的后果，并以此使暴力成为次要的东西。从赞成市场的角度看，压制是伴随全球市场扩张的冲击带来的未预见、不幸、间歇性且大概是暂时的副作用。从更具批判性的视角，即马克思主义传统的视角看，暴力是资本主义发展的常见工具，尤其是资本主义关系渗透新领域时的工具。如马克思本人所说，在生产关系变革落后于资本全球历史的地区，往往需要暴力来“像温室一样”加速资本主义的发展。
然而，正因如此，暴力必须被视为“一种常见的偶然性”，而不是“逻辑上必然”的东西。
它有助于资本的逻辑，但作为随机性和不可预测性的要素，或者作为单纯强行加快历史步伐的手段，它必须是偶然的，或外在于历史逻辑本身的。

en: I would argue against either approach to the question of violence. In both cases the violence becomes something residual, either the unexpected side effect of the development of capitalism or merely the contingent instrument of its logic. The secondary or reserve nature of violence is required if one is to present history in terms of the unfolding of a larger logic. By homogenizing contemporary politics into ineluctable and universal logics of capitalist globalization, we attribute to reform programs, to the market, to capital, or to globalization a coherence, energy, and rationality that they could never otherwise claim. To counteract this tendency we need to put together accounts of contemporary politics, as I have tried to do here, that bring to light the incoherences, reversals, and reformulations that accompany the apparent logics of globalization. The continuous political struggles under way in places such as Egypt are not the consequences of a more global logic, but an active political process whose significance is repeatedly marginalized and overlooked in reproducing the simple narratives of globalization, whether for or against.
zh: 我要反对对待暴力问题的这两种进路。在两种情况下，暴力都成为某种残余之物：要么是资本主义发展的意外副作用，要么仅仅是其逻辑的偶然工具。如果要以某个更大逻辑的展开来呈现历史，就需要把暴力视为次要或储备性的。通过把当代政治同质化为资本主义全球化不可逃避的普遍逻辑，我们把一种它们本来永远无法主张的连贯性、能量和理性赋予了改革计划、市场、资本或全球化。为了对抗这一倾向，我们需要汇集关于当代政治的叙述——正如我在此尝试做的——揭示伴随全球化表面逻辑而来的不连贯、逆转和重新表述。埃及等地正在进行的持续政治斗争，不是某种更全球性逻辑的后果，而是一个活跃的政治过程；在再生产全球化的简单叙事时——无论是赞成还是反对——其意义不断被边缘化和忽视。

en: The third point also relates to this question of other logics, and represents another feature and difficulty of enframing. As Callon stresses, the interactions that must be contained within the economy are not merely those among human agents. An economy is assembled out of a variety of agencies and forces, some human and some nonhuman. The powers that combine to make an economy include those of machines, humans, corporations, money, electrical and other forms of energy, technology, and chemical and biological processes, among others. In chapter 1, for example, I examined in a critical period of Egyptian politics the multiple interactions of human agency with the technology of war, the virulence of epidemic disease, the unexpected properties of DDT, the dual use of artificial nitrates, and the hydropower of the river Nile. In economic science, a fundamental distinction is made between the agency of humans and the role of all the other elements of an economy, which by contrast are considered essentially passive. The latter are treated as inputs (raw materials or machinery, for example), and are represented in terms of their cost to the human agents. This conventional view of things aids certain kinds of economic calculation, but is an incomplete and unsatisfactory account of how economic relations occur.
zh: 第三点也与其他逻辑的问题有关，并代表了框架化的另一个特征和困难。正如卡隆所强调的，必须被容纳在经济内部的互动，不只是人类行动者之间的互动。经济由多种能动主体和力量组装而成，有些是人的，有些是非人的。组合起来构成经济的力量包括机器、人、公司、货币、电力和其他形式的能源、技术，以及化学和生物过程等。例如，在第1章中，我考察了埃及政治一个关键时期人的能动性与战争技术、流行病的毒力、DDT的意外特性、人工硝酸盐的双重用途以及尼罗河水力之间的多重互动。在经济科学中，人的能动作用与经济中所有其他要素的作用被作出根本区分，后者相比之下被认为本质上是消极被动的。后者被当作投入品（例如原材料或机器），并以它们对人类行动者的成本来表示。这种关于事物的常规看法有助于某些类型的经济计算，但对经济关系如何发生给出的是一种不完整、不令人满意的说明。

en: In practice the nonhuman elements are never so passive. Those with money to invest can find themselves driven by the reproductive yet unstable power of capital. Those developing a technology can be quite surprised by its outcome. Those putting physical, chemical, or biological processes to work, whether in a cement kiln, a pumping station, a mobile phone network, or a field of sugarcane, enter into a partnership with processes whose fate they do not completely command. There will always be what Latour calls “the slight surprise of action,” the tendency of the human agent to be “slightly overtaken by the action.”

The nonhuman agencies enter into human partnership not just as passive elements to be costed and arranged, but as dynamic and mobile forces with their own powers and logics. Economic practice always comes into being in combination with these noneconomic elements, which it cannot fully contain or account for.
zh: 在实践中，非人要素从来不会如此被动。有钱可投资的人会发现自己被资本那种具有再生产性却不稳定的力量所驱动。开发某项技术的人可能会对其结果大为惊讶。那些让物理、化学或生物过程发挥作用的人——无论是在水泥窑、泵站、移动电话网络还是甘蔗田里——都进入了与一些过程的合伙关系，而这些过程的命运并不完全由他们掌控。总会有拉图尔所说的“行动的小小意外”，即人类行动者“稍稍被行动超越”的倾向。
非人能动主体进入人类合伙关系，不只是作为可计算和安排成本收益的被动要素，而是作为拥有自身力量和逻辑的动态、流动的力量。经济实践总是在与这些非经济要素的结合中形成，而它无法完全容纳或计入这些要素。

en: Even the element that economics takes as the origin and essence of the economic process, individual human utility or desire, is neither an absolute origin nor a simple, human essence. On the one hand, desires must constantly be manufactured, generated within the nonhuman machinery of consumption industries or even the psychological and biochemical mechanisms of addiction. On the other, while the concept of utility in economics is the foundation that makes possible a rational, calculable world, the utility itself stands for desire, an incalculable and irrational force that can overtake and disrupt the most carefully calculated actions. An element of irrationality, of something not quite human, inhabits the rational, human core of the economic.
zh: 甚至经济学视为经济过程起点和本质的要素——个人效用或欲望——也不是绝对的起点，也不是单纯的人的本质。一方面，欲望必须不断被制造，在消费产业非人的机器中，甚至在成瘾的心理和生化机制中产生。另一方面，尽管经济学中的效用概念是使一个理性、可计算的世界成为可能的基础，效用本身却代表着欲望——一种不可计算、非理性的力量，能够超越并扰断最精心计算的行为。一种非理性的、某种并不完全人性的要素，栖居在经济那理性的、人的核心之中。

en: To sum up, the attempt to enframe the economy occurs alongside other forms of structuring and network making, including those of the household or family, large corporations, and nation-states, all in interaction with one another. Enframing is a work of violence as well as theory. And the forces and overflows it must contain are not limited to those of human agency, whose rationality itself contains forms of the irrational and nonhuman. With these points in mind, we can return to the question of relationship between economics and the economy. We are in a better position to understand the role of economics and what seem the silences and limitations of the IMF and other official agencies in Egypt. Economic expertise is forced largely to overlook the forms of leakage, network, energy, control, violence, and irrationality I have been discussing. It cannot take them seriously, for that is not its task. The role of economics is to help make possible the economy by articulating the rules, understandings, and equivalences out of which the economic is made. This has been its impossible project. Economics is part of the enframing that attempts to make what is internal to the economy distinct from what is external, and thus make calculation and exchange possible. It is therefore obliged to treat all these other processes as something secondary, minor, or exceptional. The self-deception is essential, for otherwise it would have to follow these links, powers, and leakages, and admit that there could be no economy.
zh: 总而言之，为经济设定框架的尝试，与其他形式的结构化和网络建构同时发生，包括家户或家庭、大公司和民族国家的结构化，它们彼此互动。框架化既是理论工作，也是暴力工作。而它必须容纳的力量和溢出，并不限于人类能动作用，人类能动作用本身的理性就包含非理性和非人的形式。带着这些观点，我们可以回到经济学与经济之间关系的问题。我们如今更能理解经济学的作用，以及IMF和其他官方机构在埃及问题上看似沉默和局限的表现。经济学专业知识在很大程度上被迫忽视我一直在讨论的渗漏、网络、能量、控制、暴力和非理性形式。它不能认真对待它们，因为这不是它的任务。经济学的作用，是通过阐述构成经济的规则、理解和等价关系，帮助使经济成为可能。这一直是它不可能完成的计划。经济学是框架化的一部分，框架化试图把经济内部之物与经济外部之物区分开，从而使计算和交换成为可能。因此，它不得不把所有其他过程当作次要、微小或例外的东西。这种自我欺骗是本质性的，否则它就必须追踪这些联系、力量和渗漏，并承认不可能存在什么经济。

en: Economics must start from the assumption that the act of exchange, and the aggregation of all acts of exchange in the economy, occur essentially as forms of closure or equilibrium. The exchange or the economy must be self-contained, and thus in principle measurable and manageable. It is well known that economics begins from this abstraction, from a model, and considers what actually occurs as secondary, as an approximation to this model or a deviation from it. But this is not just a methodological preference, expressing a desire for a certain form of scientific rigor. It reflects the fact that the complex social world of the science must be simplified in the same way, and that economics is hard at work in this project of simplification. The existence of an economy depends upon these methods in practice: methods of designating certain costs as external, certain claims as secondary.
zh: 经济学必须从这样的假定出发：交换行为，以及经济中所有交换行为的加总，本质上都是以封闭或均衡的形式发生的。交换或经济必须是自足的，从而原则上可衡量、可管理。众所周知，经济学从这种抽象、从一个模型出发，把实际发生的事情视为次要的，视为对该模型的近似或偏离。但这不只是方法论偏好，不只是表达对某种科学严谨性的追求。它反映了这样一个事实：这门科学的复杂社会世界必须被同样地简化，而经济学正致力于这项简化工程。经济的存在在实践中依赖于这些方法：把某些成本指定为外部成本、把某些主张指定为次要主张的方法。

en: Likewise, making the economy depends upon instituting a fundamental separation between human action and the world in which this action occurs. If economics attributes agency only to human actors and treats all other forces as a passive world of nature, this corresponds to an entire politics of the twentieth century. The construction of the first great barrage at Aswan in southern Egypt at the start of the century, the centerpiece of Britain’s colonial project, established on the ground forms of calculation, engineering, control, and profit that simplified the world into nature on one side and economy on the other. On the one hand were the natural resources of the Nile, agricultural lands, irrigation systems, and hydropower, on the other the human agency that could calculate, transform, manage, and make wealth from these material elements. Again, if economics treats economic relations as essentially rational and consensual, and reduces coercion and violence to residual questions of enforcement and sanction, this corresponds to the discipline’s role in the larger project of embedding the exercise of coercion in the forces of nature and the laws of markets—in subsuming them under logics of history, capital, or exchange.
zh: 同样，经济的制造依赖于在人类行动和这种行动发生的世界之间建立根本的分离。如果经济学只把能动性赋予人类行动者，并把所有其他力量当作被动的自然世界，那么这与20世纪的一整套政治相对应。该世纪初在埃及南部阿斯旺建造的第一座大坝——英国殖民计划的核心——在现实中确立了计算、工程、控制和利润的形式，把世界简化为一边是自然、另一边是经济。一边是尼罗河、农田、灌溉系统和水电等自然资源，另一边是能够计算、改造、管理这些物质要素并从中创造财富的人类能动性。再者，如果经济学把经济关系视为本质上理性和共识性的，并把强制和暴力化约为执行与制裁的残余问题，那么这与该学科在一个更大工程中的角色相对应：把强制的行使嵌入自然力量和市场的规律之中——把它归入历史、资本或交换的逻辑之下。

en: At the start of this discussion I called the economy a fabrication, but that term should not be misunderstood. It does not mean that the economy is merely a work of imagination, or that the problem with the economy is that it is not real. Such criticisms slide back into the language of real versus imaginary, original versus copy, an object world versus its representation. These distinctions are complicit in the project of making the economy and cannot be used to understand it. As we saw in the first three chapters, the politics of the late-nineteenth and twentieth centuries attempted to organize a world whose complexities were resolved into the simple dualities of real and representation, objects and ideas, nature and techno-science, land and the abstraction of law, the country and the map. The social sciences emerged in the same period to confirm and reproduce this binary world. The role of economics was to produce the economy, not as a work of imagination but as a practical project. The economy is an artifactual body—a fabrication, yes, but as solid as other fabricated objects, and as incomplete.
zh: 在讨论开始时，我称经济为一种制造物，但这个说法不应被误解。它并不意味着经济仅仅是想象的产物，也不意味着经济的问题在于它不真实。这类批评滑回了真实与想象、原本与复制、对象世界与其再现之类的语言。这些区分与制造经济的工程同谋，不能用来理解它。正如我们在前三章所见，19世纪末和20世纪的政治试图组织一个世界，其复杂性被分解为真实与再现、对象与观念、自然与技术科学、土地与法律抽象、国土与地图等简单二元。社会科学在同一时期出现，以确认和再生产这个二元世界。经济学的作用是生产经济，不是作为想象作品，而是作为一项实践工程。经济是一个人工制造的躯体——是的，是一种制造物，但与其他制造出来的对象一样坚实，也一样不完整。

en: Thus economic discourse works very hard to help format and reproduce the exclusions that make the economy possible. This is why there are no particular farmers or villages in economic discourse on Egypt. It is the reason why the Sawiris family and Ahmed Bahgat, the Seoudi group and the Metwallis, are never encountered in the writings of the IMF. It is why nowhere in the reports of USAID can one discover the role of government ministers, senior officials, and their families in the rent circuits of the socalled private sector. It is why the extensive importing, manufacturing, and consumption of goods by the Egyptian armed forces are left opaque in official statistics. Examining any one of these issues leads away from a closed economy, away from the map, away from what is transparent and calculable, into farming, households, family, state, and power. The closure unravels.
zh: 因此，经济话语非常努力地帮助格式化和再生产那些使经济成为可能的排除。这就是为什么关于埃及的经济话语中没有具体的农民或村庄。这就是为什么在IMF的著述中从不会遇到萨维里斯家族和艾哈迈德·巴赫加特、塞乌迪集团和梅特瓦利家族。这就是为什么在美国国际开发署的报告中，人们无处发现政府部长、高级官员及其家族在所谓私营部门的地租循环中的作用。这就是为什么埃及武装部队大规模的进口、制造和消费在官方统计中保持不透明。考察其中任何一个问题，都会使人离开封闭的经济，离开地图，离开透明和可计算之物，进入农业、家户、家庭、国家和权力。封闭就此松散开来。

en: The project of economic reform in Egypt was a work of theory and violence. Making the market economy required a series of framings, which attempted to fix and to exclude. Less than a decade after the project began, it had come apart. The confident success story told by the IMF and the government media was no longer possible to sustain.
zh: 埃及的经济改革工程既是理论工作，也是暴力工作。制造市场经济需要一系列框架化操作，试图固定和排除。工程开始不到十年，它就瓦解了。IMF和政府媒体所讲述的自信成功故事再也无法维持。

en: The Cairo stock market had collapsed, losing almost 50 percent of its value during the year 2000. By the end of that year prices were lower than when the government first revived the exchange in 1995.

The real estate boom had gone bust. Ahmed Bahgat, the builder of Dreamland, suffered a heart attack in July 2000 while on a trip to Washington, where he was part of an official delegation making an unsuccessful effort to encourage investments from large U.S. corporations. When news reached Cairo that he was in the hospital in Bethesda, Maryland, undergoing surgery to the aorta, shares in his company collapsed. Dreamland was effectively bankrupt. Beverly Hills and most of the other, smaller developments also came to a halt as speculators discovered they had overbuilt, and luxury property prices dropped by more than half.

Public sector entrepreneurs were in the same trouble. The debts of the Radio and Television Union, the commercial arm of the Ministry of Information creating the media complex next door to Beverly Hills, reached E£3.8 billion, and the Ministry of Finance had to bail it out.
The Arab Contractors Company, the family-run, state-owned construction corporation building Media Production City and many other large projects, was facing financial crisis.

There was panic in the banks, which had overextended credit for real estate projects. The chairman of the National Bank of Egypt, the bank with the largest investments in failed speculations, was removed.
zh: 开罗股市崩溃，2000年一年间损失了近50%的价值。到那年底，股价低于政府1995年首次恢复交易所时的水平。
房地产繁荣已经破灭。梦幻乐园的建造者艾哈迈德·巴赫加特在2000年7月赴华盛顿途中突发心脏病；他当时是一个官方代表团的成员，该代表团试图鼓励美国大公司投资，但未成功。当他因主动脉手术住进马里兰州贝塞斯达医院的消息传到开罗时，他公司的股票暴跌。梦幻乐园实际上已经破产。比弗利山庄和其他大多数较小的开发项目也陷入停顿，因为投机者发现他们建设过度，豪华房地产价格下跌了一半以上。
公共部门的企业家也陷入同样的麻烦。新闻部的商业机构广播电视联盟正在比弗利山庄旁边建设媒体综合体，其债务达到38亿埃镑，财政部不得不对其进行纾困。
阿拉伯承包商公司——这家家族经营、国有的建筑公司正在建设媒体制作城和许多其他大型项目——面临金融危机。
银行为房地产项目过度放贷，陷入恐慌。埃及国家银行是在失败投机中投资最多的银行，其董事长被撤换。

en: As a recession set in and the government began to fall far behind on domestic payments, other businesses whose prosperity came from contracts with the state began to fail. Rami Lakah, the thirty-nine-year-old entrepreneur who had developed the country’s largest business group by building fee-paying government hospitals for the affluent, hailed in 1999 as the first Egyptian enterprise to borrow on the international bond market, within a year had fled the country. He returned only after the government and the banks agreed to reschedule his debts, which were reported to have reached E£1.5 billion.

“Cost recovery” in health care had acquired a new meaning. As the government tried to slow the flow of funds the supply of dollars dried up, affecting importers, including manufacturers, who needed supplies from abroad. Toward the end of 2000 the government was forced to give up the attempt to peg the currency to the dollar, and the Egyptian pound lost 20 percent of its value. Almost the only economic activity that seemed to thrive was the use of mobile telephones. The country’s million or so subscribers used four times as many minutes per month per subscriber as the worldwide average. The E£5.6 billion they spent talking on their telephones in 2000 exceeded the country’s revenue that year from exports.
zh: 随着衰退开始，政府开始严重拖欠国内付款，其他靠与国家合同而兴旺的企业也开始倒闭。三十九岁的企业家拉米·拉卡通过为富人建造收费的政府医院，发展出该国最大的商业集团，1999年被誉为第一家在国际债券市场借款的埃及企业；不到一年，他就逃离了该国。直到政府和银行同意重新安排他的债务——据报道已达15亿埃镑——他才回国。
医疗保健中的“成本回收”有了新的含义。政府试图减缓资金流动，美元供应随之枯竭，影响到进口商，包括需要海外供应的制造商。2000年底，政府被迫放弃盯住美元的尝试，埃及镑贬值20%。几乎唯一似乎兴旺的经济活动就是使用移动电话。该国约一百万用户每人每月使用的分钟数是全球平均水平的四倍。他们在2000年打电话花费的56亿埃镑，超过了该国当年的出口收入。

en: Some blamed the money spent on mobile phone conversations for the country’s recession. Others blamed it on the off-budget spending by the state. The government had pushed ahead with what it called its “Pharaonic” development projects, concentrating its resources on the most ambitious of them, the Toshka irrigation scheme. Convinced, like the United States Agency for International Development, that Egypt’s fundamental problems were defined by the limits of natural resources—not enough land, too many people—it pursued President Mubarak’s dream of creating a second river Nile in the desert. Toshka was a very twentieth-century idea. The century that opened with the construction of the first Aswan Dam ended with an even bigger project, not just to store up all the waters of the world’s longest river, but to divert them to build another.
zh: 有人把该国的衰退归咎于花在手机通话上的钱。另一些人把它归咎于国家的预算外支出。政府推进其所谓的“法老式”开发项目，把资源集中于其中最雄心勃勃的托什卡灌溉工程。政府同美国国际开发署一样确信，埃及的根本问题由自然资源的限制所界定——土地不够，人口太多——于是追求穆巴拉克总统在沙漠中创造第二条尼罗河的梦想。托什卡是一个十足的20世纪观念。以建造第一座阿斯旺大坝开场的那个世纪，以一个更大的工程收尾：不仅要蓄起世界最长河流的全部水量，还要把水引走，另造一条河。

en: Dreamland was an amusement park in the desert, a mirage under construction, a place of desire promised in television commercials and newspaper advertisements long before it was finished. Perhaps it would remain forever a mirage, an unfulfilled desire. It was one of many dreamlands. Toshka was the object of a ruler’s desire, as he passed his seventieth birthday, to build something by which his rule would be remembered, a fairy tale to be fulfilled with the help of a billionaire prince and the bankrupt owner of Superior SeedlessTM grapes. These dreamlands are the places of desire that global capitalism cannot contain.
zh: 梦幻乐园是沙漠中的一座游乐园，一个正在建设中的海市蜃楼，一个早在完工之前就在电视广告和报纸广告中被许诺的欲望之地。也许它会永远是一个海市蜃楼，一个未满足的欲望。它是众多梦幻乐园之一。托什卡是一个统治者在年过七旬之际的欲望对象：建造某种能让人记住其统治的东西，一个要靠亿万富翁亲王和“超级无籽”葡萄的破产所有者的帮助来实现的童话。这些梦幻乐园是全球资本主义无法容纳的欲望场所。

en: Capitalism, as I proposed in chapter 1, has no singular logic, no essence. It survives parasitically, like the Plasmodium falciparum, taking up residence in human bodies and minds, or in sugarcane or private property, drawing its energies from the chemistry of others, its force from other fields, its momentum from others’ desires. The projects of economic reform in Egypt had to excite the desires that fueled the building of Dreamland and Toshka, yet capitalism could not discipline those desires. Such desires, such forces, such other logics, are presented as something exterior to capitalism. They appear as a noncapitalist excess that derails capitalism from its course. Yet this outside, these excesses, are at the same time vital to capitalism. They are a source of its energies, the condition of its success, the possibility of its power to reproduce. They are a heterogeneity that makes possible the logic of capital, and thus ensures both its powers and its failures.
zh: 正如我在第1章所提出的，资本主义没有单一的逻辑，没有本质。它像恶性疟原虫一样寄生存活，寄居于人的身体和心灵，或甘蔗和私有财产之中，从他人的化学机制中汲取能量，从其他场域中汲取力量，从他人的欲望中获得动力。埃及的经济改革计划必须激发那些推动梦幻乐园和托什卡建设的欲望，然而资本主义无法约束这些欲望。这些欲望、这些力量、这些其他逻辑，被呈现为资本主义外部的东西。它们显得是一种非资本主义的过度，使资本主义脱离其轨道。然而这个外部、这些过度，同时又是资本主义生死攸关的东西。它们是资本主义能量的来源、其成功的条件、其再生产能力之可能。它们是一种异质性，使资本的逻辑成为可能，从而同时保证其力量和失败。

en: The scramble also reflected a global reorganization of the cement industry. A decade earlier there had been no global cement makers. But declining growth in their home markets led these three companies to expand around the world, following the path of financial crises—and hence cheap acquisitions— first into Latin America, then into East Asia, and by the late 1990s into the Middle East and Africa, regions where expanding populations promised long-term growth (cement production is driven by demographics). In 1997 Holderbank, the world’s largest cement maker with operations in sixty countries, including subsidiaries in Morocco and Lebanon, purchased 25 percent of the Egyptian Cement Company and began to build three new kilns near Suez. In July 1999 Lafarge S.A., the world’s largest building products group and second largest cement maker, also operating in sixty countries, purchased 76 percent of Beni Suef Cement, and was set to increase its share to 95 percent. It arranged to then sell half its holding of Beni Suef Cement to the Greek cement company Titan, which already owned two cement-importing facilities in Egypt jointly with the local 4M Group, Egypt’s largest importer of construction materials. In November 1999 the government sold 90 percent of Assiut Cement to Cemex of Mexico, the largest cement producer in the Americas, and sold 74 percent of Alexandria Portland Cement to Blue Circle Industries, the largest British cement producer with operations in Europe and Africa. See EIU, Egypt: Country Report, 3rd quarter 1999, 20–21; Business Monthly, Jan. 2000, 18; http://www.cemex.com; http://www.titan.gr/en/news; http://www.4mgroup. com.eg; http://www.holderbank.com; and http://www.lafarge.fr.
zh: 这一争抢也反映了水泥行业的全球重组。十年前还没有全球性的水泥制造商。但本土市场增长下滑，促使这三家公司向世界各地扩张，沿着金融危机的路径——因而也是廉价收购的路径——先进入拉丁美洲，再进入东亚，到1990年代末进入中东和非洲；这些地区人口不断增长，预示着长期增长（水泥生产受人口结构驱动）。1997年，世界最大水泥制造商霍尔班克（Holderbank）在六十个国家经营，包括在摩洛哥和黎巴嫩的子公司，购入了埃及水泥公司25%的股份，并开始在苏伊士附近建造三座新窑。1999年7月，世界最大建材集团、第二大水泥制造商拉法基集团（Lafarge S.A.）——同样在六十个国家经营——购入了贝尼苏韦夫水泥公司76%的股份，并准备将持股增至95%。它随后安排将所持贝尼苏韦夫水泥的一半出售给希腊水泥公司泰坦（Titan），后者已与当地4M集团——埃及最大的建材进口商——合资在埃及拥有两家水泥进口设施。1999年11月，政府将阿斯尤特水泥公司90%的股份出售给墨西哥水泥公司（Cemex）——美洲最大的水泥生产商，并将亚历山大利亚波特兰水泥公司74%的股份出售给蓝圈工业公司（Blue Circle Industries）——英国最大的水泥生产商，业务遍及欧洲和非洲。见 EIU, Egypt: Country Report, 3rd quarter 1999, 20–21; Business Monthly, Jan. 2000, 18; http://www.cemex.com; http://www.titan.gr/en/news; http://www.4mgroup.com.eg; http://www.holderbank.com; and http://www.lafarge.fr.

en: Another large industrialization project of the 1990s, described as a leading example of the new private sector–funded, export-oriented investment (and the first big Egyptian-Israeli industrial venture), turned out to be relying on state funds and to be oriented, once again, to the domestic market. The Middle East Oil Refinery (Midor), a project to build a $1.5 billion oil refinery announced in 1996 by the Swiss-based Masaka company, owned by an Egyptian financier, Hussein Salem, and the Israeli Merhav Group, owned by Yosef Maiman, failed to attract private investment. So the Egyptian government increased its funding to 60 percent, the two private financiers reduced their shares to 20 percent each, and the Egyptian-Swiss partner passed on all except 2 percent of this share to other, mostly state-owned Egyptian finance houses (16 percent to NBE Finance of the Cayman Islands, an off-shore subsidiary of the National Bank of Egypt, and 2 percent to the local joint sector Suez Canal Bank). Instead of refining petroleum products for export, the government announced, most of the production would be for the domestic market. EIU, Egypt: Country Report, 3rd quarter 1999, 27.

en: Leading economists frequently acknowledge the difficulty of measuring the economy. Asking why “economists have not been very successful in explaining what has happened to the economy during the last two decades,” Zvi Griliches, in his 1994 address as president of the American Economic Association (AEA), argued that whereas in the 1950s about half the overall economy was measurable, by 1990 the proportion had fallen to below one-third (“Productivity, R&D, and the Data Constraint,” American Economic Review 14, no. 1 [1994]: 1–23, at 13). In an earlier AEA presidential address, Robert Eisner said that measures of the main macroeconomic variables—income, output, employment, prices, productivity, consumption, savings, investment, capital formation, wealth, debt, and deficits—were so unreliable that he and his fellow economists “have literally not known what we are talking about.” “Divergences of Measurement and Theory and Some Implications for Economic Policy,” American Economic Review 79, no. 1 (1989): 1–13, at 2.
zh: 著名经济学家经常承认衡量经济的困难。兹维·格里利谢斯在1994年作为美国经济学会（AEA）会长的演讲中，追问为什么“经济学家一直未能很好地解释过去二十年经济发生了什么”，并指出：1950年代约有一半的整体经济是可衡量的，到1990年这一比例已降至三分之一以下（“Productivity, R&D, and the Data Constraint,” American Economic Review 84, no. 1 [1994]: 1–23, at 13〔校注：底本印作第14卷；据该文原刊目录及NBER重印说明订为第84卷。〕）。在更早的一次AEA会长演讲中，罗伯特·艾斯纳说，主要宏观经济变量的衡量指标——收入、产出、就业、价格、生产率、消费、储蓄、投资、资本形成、财富、债务和赤字——如此不可靠，以至于他和同行经济学家“简直不知道自己在谈论什么”（“Divergences of Measurement and Theory and Some Implications for Economic Policy,” American Economic Review 79, no. 1 [1989]: 1–13, at 2）。

en: Here is a simple example: Before a foreign food product can be imported and enter the market in Egypt, the food itself must go through some complex exchanges. At Egyptian customs it is inspected to ensure it complies with packaging and labeling regulations (language and placement of labels, production and expiration dates, ingredients, name of manufacturer and importer), local shelf-life standards (less than half the life must have expired by completion of customs inspection), and international and local product specifications. Samples of the product must be inspected in government laboratories to ensure compliance with Ministry of Health regulations on fitness for human consumption, contagious diseases, and prohibited coloring, additives, and preservatives, and international regulations on pesticide residues. See United States Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service, “Egypt: Food and Agricultural Import Regulations and Standards, Country Report 2000,” Global Agriculture Information Network, Report No. EG0023, July 30, 2000.
zh: 一个简单的例子：外国食品在获准进口并进入埃及市场之前，食品本身必须经过一些复杂的交换。在埃及海关，它要接受检查，以确保符合包装和标签规定（标签语言和位置、生产日期和保质期、成分、制造商和进口商名称）、本地保质期标准（完成海关检查时，其保质期所剩不得超过一半），以及国际和本地产品规格。产品样品必须在政府实验室检验，以确保符合卫生部关于适合人类食用、传染病以及禁用色素、添加剂和防腐剂的规定，并符合关于农药残留的国际规定。见 United States Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service, “Egypt: Food and Agricultural Import Regulations and Standards, Country Report 2000,” Global Agriculture Information Network, Report No. EG0023, July 30, 2000.

Six months later the sentences were annulled and a retrial was ordered because the investigation had violated banking secrecy laws. Tariq Hassan-Gordon, “Case of 31 Businessmen to Be Retried,” Middle East Times, Jan. 19, 2001.
zh: 2000年7月，31名被告被判有罪（第32名已死亡）。三人逃往国外，被判处十五年苦役；十四人被判处十年苦役；其余被判处一至五年。六个月后，判决被撤销，并下令重审，因为调查违反了银行保密法。Tariq Hassan-Gordon, “Case of 31 Businessmen to Be Retried,” Middle East Times, Jan. 19, 2001.
